GHA.note: No rule or authority on AI harms stated.
No government body use of an AI system stated.
Voice AI for farmers and telemedicine is only a wish, no tool is stated as piloted or built.

facts.fact: Communications Minister Sam George tasked KNUST experts to lead development of a Twi language model, with other universities to lead models for other Ghanaian languages, as the government decided national language models must be built locally.
